## Problem and resulting behavior

Describe the concrete problem and how the application behaves after this change.
Link the issue or proposal if applicable.

## Validation

List meaningful checks and outcomes. For native UI or compatibility changes,
include the exact OS/architecture and registry/archive consumer tested.

## Review checklist

- [ ] Code, comments, logs, UI and documentation use English by default.
- [ ] Module boundaries and file/function size limits are respected.
- [ ] Relevant behavioral tests and static checks pass.
- [ ] No credentials, private artifacts or sensitive diagnostics are included.
- [ ] User-visible changes and acceptance limitations are documented.
